channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Why Malta should boycott the Eurovision
item.description: The country should not be allowed to whitewash its sins through a cultural event intended to bring people together.

item.title: MUT President calls for implementation of language policy at state schools
item.description: Malta Union of Teachers head says most lessons at state schools being carried out in English

item.title: WATCH | Marco Bonnici: ‘Our schools are an identical copy of society’
item.description: One week after Malta was shocked by a stabbing in a secondary school, the president of the Malta Union of Teachers, Marco Bonnici tells Matthew Farrugia the incident means that nothing can be taken for granted in schools

item.title: The union that tries to catch two rabbits
item.description: The European Commission’s recent warning to Malta on its public finances fits neatly into this pattern

item.title: Calls for Roderick Galdes to be investigated mount following yet another deal with top developers
item.description: NGO Repubblika believes that this deal and others exposed in recent weeks appear to fit 'every reasonable definition of corruption,' describing the case as a potential abuse of public office for private gain • Galdes claims he and his family are under attack

item.title: Government to contribute €250,000 to father suffering from rare and aggressive leukaemia
item.description: After undergoing chemotherapy and two bone marrow transplants, Sandro Grech has been told that he might survive if he can raise €500,000 for a treatment which is only available in Singapore

item.title: PN will publish its accounts on Monday, Alex Borg promises
item.description: On Net TV on Sunday, Borg stated that the public will soon see the PN’s accounts throughout the years when it failed to publish them. The party’s last published financial statements were released in 2020

item.title: Australia in shock after gunmen kill 12 in beach shooting
item.description: Authorities say the Jewish community was deliberately targeted. One suspected gunman was killed, while another is in critical condition and was taken into custody

item.title: Abela says government approved yet another feasibility study on mass transport system
item.description: Prime Minister Robert Abela opposed measures that penalise private vehicle use, stating that the government prefers incentives, and that, 'We [the Maltese] love our car'
